scope: Isolated local experiment after the monthly snapshot stage; no production/staging, backups, schema, pool size or application config changes.
hypothesis: Reduce metadata round trips in the uncached monthly cost calculation without changing primary period/report reads. Both prototypes use the same Prisma client and pool. These are not deployable concurrency-safe implementations.

implementation.serial: After explicit import scope is read, await protected project parents and a single parameterized JSONB metadata packet before returning that scope.
implementation.parallel: Start the same protected project and metadata reads after scope, while original report/period queries can proceed.
packet: aliases limited to protected project IDs
day overrides limited to protected projects and import dates
overlapping absences of linked import collaborators
implementation.notAShippingDesign: The experimental preloader patches delegates in benchmark child processes. The application was not patched. Any future implementation needs scoped inputs and lazy promises, complete latest-import/permission coverage and independent full-result parity.

serialDense.method: Local paired uncached service calculations on PostgreSQL with warm database pages; not HTTP latency. Timings exclude process boot and module imports. Fresh Node/Prisma processes for every cold sample. After-session performs a SELECT, not HTTP authentication. Prisma operation profiles include mapping; sqlQueries capture pg pool calls and replay SELECTs with EXPLAIN ANALYZE after the calculation. Pool call durations overlap and include queue/event-loop delays. Initialization diagnostics run in separate processes and do not warm timed samples. Result bytes are JSON sizes, not network traffic.
serialDense.cpuMethod: process.cpuUsage delta around the calculation only, before EXPLAIN replay; includes Node/Prisma CPU, excludes PostgreSQL, module imports and process boot. CPU and wall time are separate observations.

failedCohort.name: parallelSparse
failedCohort.reasonLogNotPublished: Assertion output includes whole synthetic fixture IDs/results; retained here only as an observation and digest.
failedCohort.comparisonsCompletedBeforeFailure: not recorded by the existing harness

comparison.control: Candidate and archive are the same 3be5b9fb source, with no preloader. All nine pairs passed. This does not resolve or explain the failed experimental cohort.
comparison.orderingObservation: The existing RDO evidence reduction retains the first encountered report when hours tie. The parent read has no explicit tie order. The experiment observed different rdoNumber evidence; SQL scheduling, planner and physical row order were not traced, so causality is unresolved. No calculation rule or report ordering was changed to make the benchmark pass.

decision: Do not integrate either prototype. Serial changes have no uniform cold benefit and regress the sparse warm median; parallel dense has a 6.3% cold gain but the sparse run violates full-result parity. Retain the failed cohort and unchanged control; do not compose percentages with earlier baselines or treat a passing dense cohort as general acceptance.

acceptance.T06: unchanged: all-phase pool waiting=0 remains 90.2-90.5% in the final application cohorts
acceptance.T07: unchanged: general new-process target >=50% remains open; preceding application stage observed 44.9% sparse and 42.3% dense versus the original plan baseline

reproduction.guard: Requires PostgreSQL on loopback and a database name ending in _test. Use an isolated disposable database with all migrations; never production or a shared development database.
reproduction.baseline: Archive 3be5b9fb backend/shared and reuse matching installed dependencies. Candidate application files must have the recorded source hashes.
reproduction.order: Serial dense, serial sparse, parallel dense, failed parallel sparse, unchanged control sparse. Child source order alternates in each cohort. No tests or other task DB work during timed windows.

serial.purpose: Experimental benchmark-only preloader. Never imported by application code or CI. Replace the root placeholder with an archived candidate backend and use NODE_OPTIONS=--import=<recipe-file> only for the loopback test benchmark.

parallel.purpose: Experimental benchmark-only preloader. Never imported by application code or CI. Replace the root placeholder with an archived candidate backend and use NODE_OPTIONS=--import=<recipe-file> only for the loopback test benchmark.

limitations: Wall time varies on a shared host. Control medians differ by 2.1-7.7% even for identical application source; these few paired samples do not establish statistical or published acceptance.

Cold service timing excludes module imports/process boot and uses warm database pages; after-session means one SELECT, not HTTP authentication. No HTTP, browser, proxy/TLS or production conclusions follow from this experiment.
No rerun was used to replace the failed experimental cohort with a passing one. The only follow-up cohort is an explicitly unchanged-source diagnostic control.

The next transport experiment must first preserve complete allocation evidence under tied RDOs; compare report inputs/order without logging identifiers. Reduce actual database work without moving queue waits out of observation.
